methods.what: Monotonicity of the extreme Riemann sums under refinement: the largest value of S cannot increase and the smallest cannot decrease as δ decreases
methods.quote:

methods.what: Upper and lower sums written for two subdivisions
Common refinement of the two subdivisions and termwise subtraction giving M−m as sum of interval lengths times differences of function values
Estimate: intermediate points differ by at most 2δ, so each difference of function values is less than the oscillation d over intervals of length 2δ
